name: Shuler Strawberries and Peaches
description: In Holly Hill, SC, Shuler Strawberries and Peaches grows Strawberries and Peaches on a working berry farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. The season runs through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
